offering_description.value: Advises enterprises and public agencies on choosing technology and outsourcing providers, improving operations, and managing supplier contracts. It delivers the work through consulting teams, managed governance services, and software platforms, and sells market research to technology buyers and providers.

primary_products.value: sourcing and supplier governance software; technology market research reports; cost and performance benchmarking data

primary_services.value: technology sourcing and outsourcing advisory; digital and AI strategy consulting; managed supplier and contract governance; cost and performance benchmarking; organizational change consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: large enterprises, technology vendors, and outsourcing providers; B2G: public agencies procuring technology and outsourced services

end_markets.value: financial services; manufacturing; technology and telecommunications; healthcare; public administration

revenue_model.value: project or contract: sourcing, technology strategy, and transformation engagements; service fees: ongoing supplier and contract governance; subscription: access to market research and benchmarking data
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses client requirements and market data to advise enterprises and public agencies and manage their supplier relationships; software / platform: provides technology buyers with tools to compare suppliers and manage contracts and performance

specialization.value: related lines: technology sourcing, digital strategy, supplier governance, benchmarking, and market research

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: consulting and account teams serving enterprises, public agencies, and technology providers; online: web portals for research and benchmarking subscribers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: privacy rules such as the GDPR apply when advisory and governance work involves personal data
